parameters.help_en:

If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no<props="intl"><ph> Overview page or</ph></props> ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html

You can view the information about all products under the current account in the IoT Platform console or by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的产品信息详情

AliyunCommodityCode.description_en:
The product type, which determines whether the Thing Specification Language model feature is used.
Valid values:

iothub_senior: Uses the Thing Specification Language model.
iothub: Does not use the Thing Specification Language model
AliyunCommodityCode.description_zh:
产品类型，决定是否使用物模型功能。
取值：

iothub_senior：使用物模型。
iothub：不使用物模型

AuthType.description_en:
The authentication method for devices under the product to connect to IoT Platform.

secret: Uses the device secret for device identity authentication.

id2: Uses IoT Internet Device ID (ID²) for device identity authentication.

x509: Uses the device X.509 certificate for device identity authentication
AuthType.description_zh:
产品下的设备接入物联网平台的认证方式。

secret：使用设备密钥进行设备身份认证。

id2：使用物联网设备身份认证ID²。

x509：使用设备X.509证书进行设备身份认证

CategoryKey.description_en:
The identifier of the category to which the product belongs.
This parameter is returned if the product uses a predefined standard category Thing Specification Language model from IoT Platform.
This parameter is specific to products that use the Thing Specification Language model (AliyunCommodityCode=iothub_senior)
CategoryKey.description_zh:
产品所属品类的标识符。
产品使用了物联网平台预定义的标准品类物模型会返回此参数。
该参数为使用物模型的产品（AliyunCommodityCode=iothub_senior）的特有参数

CategoryName.description_en:
The name of the category to which the product belongs.
This parameter is returned if the product uses a predefined standard category Thing Specification Language model from IoT Platform.
This parameter is specific to products that use the Thing Specification Language model (AliyunCommodityCode=iothub_senior)
CategoryName.description_zh:
产品所属品类的名称。
产品使用了物联网平台预定义的标准品类物模型会返回此参数。
该参数为使用物模型的产品（AliyunCommodityCode=iothub_senior）的特有参数

DataFormat.description_en:
The data communication protocol type between the device and the cloud. This parameter is specific to products that use the Thing Specification Language model (AliyunCommodityCode=iothub_senior).
Valid values:

0: Pass-through mode. A custom serial data format is used. In this mode, devices can report raw data such as binary data streams. IoT Platform runs the data parsing script that you configured in the cloud to convert the raw data into the Alink JSON standard data format.

1: Alink JSON. The data exchange protocol between devices and the cloud defined by IoT Platform, in JSON format
DataFormat.description_zh:
设备与云端之间的数据通信协议类型。该参数为使用物模型的产品（AliyunCommodityCode=iothub_senior）的特有参数。
取值：

0：透传模式。使用自定义的串口数据格式。该模式下，设备可以上报原始数据（如二进制数据流）。阿里云物联网平台会运行您配置在云端的数据解析脚本，将原始数据转换成Alink JSON标准数据格式。

1：Alink JSON。阿里云物联网平台定义的设备与云端的数据交换协议，采用 JSON 格式

DeviceCount.description_en: The number of devices under the product

Id2.description_en:

true: Uses ID²-based authentication.

false: Does not use ID²-based authentication

该产品是否使用ID²认证。取值：

true：使用ID²认证。

false：不使用ID²认证

NetType.description_en:
The network connectivity type of devices under the product. Valid values:

3: Wi-Fi.

6: Cellular (2G/3G/4G/5G) cellular network.

7: Ethernet.

8: Other
NetType.description_zh:
产品下设备的联网方式。取值：

3：Wi-Fi。

6：Cellular（2G/3G/4G/5G）蜂窝网。

7：Ethernet以太网。

8：其他

NodeType.description_en:
The node type of the product. This parameter is specific to products that use the Thing Specification Language model (AliyunCommodityCode=iothub_senior). Valid values:

0: Device. A device cannot have sub-devices attached. It can connect to IoT Hub directly or connect to IoT Hub as a sub-device of a gateway.

1: Gateway. A gateway can have sub-devices attached. It has a sub-device management module, maintains the topology of sub-devices, and can synchronize the topology to the cloud
NodeType.description_zh:
产品的节点类型。该参数为使用物模型的产品（AliyunCommodityCode=iothub_senior）的特有参数。取值：

0：设备。设备不能挂载子设备，可以直连IoT Hub，也可以作为网关的子设备连接IoT Hub。

1：网关。网关可以挂载子设备，具有子设备管理模块，维持子设备的拓扑关系，并且可以将拓扑关系同步到云端

Owner.description_en:
Indicates whether the caller is the owner of the product.

true: Yes.

false: No
Owner.description_zh:
调用者是否是产品的拥有者。

true：是。

false：不是

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product. A globally unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the product when it was created
ProductKey.description_zh: 产品的ProductKey。创建产品时，物联网平台为该产品颁发的全局唯一标识

RELEASE_STATUS: The product has been published

产品的状态。

ProtocolType.description_en:
The protocol type used by sub-devices to connect to the gateway.
This parameter is specific to products that use the Thing Specification Language model (AliyunCommodityCode=iothub_senior) and whose node type is a device that connects to a gateway. Valid values:

modbus: Modbus protocol.

opc-ua: OPC UA protocol.

customize: Custom protocol.

ble: BLE protocol.

zigbee: ZigBee protocol
ProtocolType.description_zh:
子设备接入网关的协议类型。
此参数为使用物模型的产品（AliyunCommodityCode=iothub_senior），且产品节点类型为要接入网关的设备的特有参数。取值：

modbus：Modbus协议。

opc-ua：OPC UA协议。

customize：自定义协议。

ble：BLE协议。

zigbee：ZigBee协议

ValidateType.description_en:
Full data validation level. Valid values:

2: No validation. No validation is performed on reported data, and all data is forwarded.

    Full data is not displayed on the TSL Data tab of the Device Details page in the IoT Platform console.

1: Weak validation. Only the identifier and dataType fields of device data are validated. Other fields are not validated, and all data is forwarded.


0: Strong validation. All fields are validated, and only data that passes validation is forwarded.
    
For products created before October 14, 2020 (exclusive), only strong validation is supported.

For products created on or after October 14, 2020, weak validation and no validation are supported.

After strong or weak validation:

Data that passes validation is displayed on the TSL Data tab of the Device Details page in the IoT Platform console. Data that fails validation is not displayed.

You can view data that fails validation by using the checkFailedData parameter in data forwarding. For more information, see [Data formats]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73736.html）
ValidateType.description_zh:
数据校验级别。可取值：

2：免校验。对上报的数据不进行校验，流转全量数据。

    数据不展示在物联网平台控制台对应设备的设备详情页物模型数据页签。

1：弱校验。只校验设备数据的idetifier和dataType字段，不校验其他字段，流转全量数据。


0：强校验。校验所有字段，仅流转校验通过的数据。
    
对于2020年10月14日之前（不含当日）创建的产品，仅支持强校验。

对于2020年10月14日（含当日）之后创建的产品，支持弱校验和免校验。

强校验和弱校验后：

校验通过的数据展示在物联网平台控制台对应设备的设备详情页物模型数据页签。校验不通过的数据则不展示。

通过流转数据中的参数checkFailedData，可查看校验不通过的数据，请参见[数据格式]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73736.html）
